name: Triage new GitHub issues with an AI agent and a human approval step
description: When a new GitHub issue is opened, an AI agent reads it, uses the GitHub tools to look for duplicates, and proposes labels, a priority and a comment for the author. A person reviews the proposal in an approval form and can edit the comment. Only approved triage is applied: the labels are added and the comment is posted; a rejection leaves the issue untouched.
shortDescription: An AI agent proposes labels and a comment for each new GitHub issue, and a person approves before anything is written.
keyFeatures: AI Agent with two GitHub tools, List repository issues and Get issue, to find duplicates
Structured JSON response with labels, priority, duplicates, reasoning and a draft comment
Approval step after the agent, with the draft comment editable in the form
Nothing is written to GitHub unless a person approves
prerequisites: GitHub connection with access to the repository
The repository owner and name set in the trigger, both tools and both GitHub steps (replace your-github-account and your-repository)
Labels bug, enhancement, question, documentation and duplicate created in the repository
Server public URL configured, so the approval form link can be generated
idealFor: Open source maintainers and engineering teams that want new issues triaged by AI without letting it label or comment on its own.
steps: Trigger: poll GitHub for a newly opened issue.
Propose triage: the AI Agent searches open issues for duplicates with its GitHub tools and returns labels, a priority, duplicates, its reasoning and a draft comment.
Approve triage: the run pauses on an approval form that shows the proposal and lets the reviewer edit the comment.
Approved: add the proposed labels to the issue and post the approved comment.
Rejected: log the rejection and the reviewer's note, leaving the issue unchanged.
